get.summary: Asset Activity and Expiry report (JSON, paged)

get.description: The same columns as the JSON report for every matching asset, one row per asset in assetUri order. The response carries X-Export-Id; GET /api/v1/reporting/reports/expiry/exports/{exportId}/manifest returns the SHA-256 of the exact bytes, the row count and the filters. A file with no matching manifest is incomplete. Empty cells are unknown values. The export walks the catalog by keyset, so an asset written while it runs is never skipped or repeated; one written ahead of the walk is included and one written behind it is not.
